findings.affected_population_system: WAFA reports two unnamed people killed and an unspecified number of other people injured by an Israeli drone strike; identification and civilian/combatant status unknown. findings.source_type: Established Palestinian national news agency reporting a local incident; no independent confirmation found in bounded checks

bounded_discovery_context.deduplication: Distinct al-Zeitoun drone strike after WAFA's 12:16 Palestine time casualty aggregate. Two deaths increase reported since-ceasefire total from 1,614 to 1,616 and should not be counted as an independent addition to a later aggregate containing this strike. Different location/event from earlier Khan Younis gunshot fatality and fisherman injury.
bounded_discovery_context.limitations: WAFA was the only direct case-specific source verified; injury count, victims' names, ages, civilian status, independent corroboration, and precise event time are unknown. Gaza health ministry primary source not independently verified.
